description.zh: 编号网格中的宝藏会短暂出现后藏起；G1-G2 还会展示一条真实路线，藏起后由孩子按顺序重建。G2 的部分路线题会在原路线消失后更新一步。任务只要求记住实际展示过的路线，不要求寻找最短或最佳路线。
description.en: Treasure markers briefly appear in a numbered grid and then hide. G1-G2 also show an actual route that the child rebuilds in order after it disappears, and some G2 route items update one hidden step. The task recalls a presented route rather than finding a shortest or best route.

designModel.zh: K1-K2 聚焦位置回忆；G1-G2 在同一空间记忆家族中混合位置题与路径题。路径题先展示连续路线，再隐藏并要求按顺序点击；G2 可替换一个仍与前后步骤相邻的中间位置。路线由题目直接展示，因此属于记忆重建而不是路线规划。
designModel.en: K1-K2 focus on location recall. G1-G2 mix location and path items in the same spatial-memory family. A path item shows a connected route, hides it, and asks for ordered taps; G2 may replace one interior position while preserving adjacency to its neighbours. Because the route is directly presented, this is memory reconstruction rather than route planning.

cognitiveChain.noteZh: 位置题覆盖观察、保持与空间定位提取；路径题进一步要求重建实际展示过的路线并据记忆执行点击。G2 的一步替换增加空间更新与工作记忆加工。
cognitiveChain.noteEn: Location items cover observation, retention and spatial retrieval. Path items additionally reconstruct an actually presented route through memory-guided taps. G2 one-step replacement adds spatial updating and working-memory manipulation.

ageRange.noteZh: K1-K2 使用 2×2 位置回忆；G1 加入 3 步路线重建；G2 加入 4 步路线及一步空间更新。
ageRange.noteEn: K1-K2 use 2x2 location recall; G1 adds three-step route reconstruction; G2 adds four-step routes and a one-step spatial update.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块训练藏起后的空间位置与已展示路线记忆。路径题的正确路线已由题目给出，孩子只需保持、更新并重建，不比较路线长短或制定行动策略，因此与 Strategy Master 的路线规划保持明确边界。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module trains memory for hidden spatial locations and presented routes. The correct route is supplied before it disappears; the child retains, updates and reconstructs it without comparing route quality or planning a strategy, preserving the boundary from Strategy Master.

geneReporting.ruleZh: K1-G1 上报 RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC；G2 同时上报 RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC 与 RG.MEMORY.WORKING.MANIPULATION。
geneReporting.ruleEn: K1-G1 report RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC; G2 reports both RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC and RG.MEMORY.WORKING.MANIPULATION.

difficultyAxes.noteEn: The grid's side length: K1-K2 use 2x2 (4 cells), G1-G2 use 3x3 (9 cells).

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 同时藏起的宝藏格数，G2 起为两处，记住其中一处即可答对。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many cells hide a treasure at once; from G2 there are two, and remembering either is enough to answer.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 宝藏藏起来之后、选项能点之前的等待时间，越长越考验记忆保持而非瞬时印象。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The wait between the treasure hiding and the options becoming clickable; a longer wait tests sustained retention rather than an instant impression.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: K1-K2 不含路径题；G1 重建 3 步路线；G2 重建 4 步路线。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: K1-K2 have no path items; G1 rebuilds three steps and G2 rebuilds four.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: G2 的部分路径题在原路线隐藏后替换一个中间步骤。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: Some G2 path items replace one interior step after the original route hides.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，通过线 75%（6/8）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 2×2 格子里记住一处宝藏，藏起来后立刻能选。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Remember one treasure in a 2x2 grid; answer as soon as it hides.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 2×2 格子，藏起来后要等一下才能选。
levelMap.objectiveEn: A 2x2 grid, with a short wait before answering is allowed.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 3×3 网格中回忆宝藏位置，并按顺序重建实际展示过的 3 步路线。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Recall treasure locations in a 3x3 grid and rebuild an actually presented three-step route in order.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 回忆位置与 4 步路线，并在部分路线题中应用一个隐藏后宣布的一步更新。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Recall locations and four-step routes, applying a one-step update in some path items.

statistics.noteZh: 位置题区分 treasure 与 empty_cell；路径题记录路径重建、空间更新、重试与 Replay 使用情况。
statistics.noteEn: Location items distinguish treasure from empty_cell; path items record route reconstruction, spatial updates, retries and Replay use.
